title: Book of Job as a deliberate Mithraic-Kabbalistic text tied to the Achaemenid Magi's restoration of Israel

tellings.quote: And look, now I make a complicated argument for that. In Iranian Leviathan, you have to look at like in the Acemened Persian Empire, who were the Mithraic Magi who were involved with the project of recreating Israel, the first Zionist project in history.

plain: The idea is that the Book of Job in the Bible was written on purpose as a coded text mixing the worship of Mithra, an ancient Persian god, with Jewish mystical teaching, by the Magi, the priests of the Achaemenid Persian Empire who, he says, helped rebuild Israel in what he calls "the first Zionist project in history." A researcher named Jason Jorjani makes this argument on the show, drawing on his own book Iranian Leviathan, without naming other sources. If right, a central biblical book would have Persian priestly roots.
